app.name: Kick Downloader
startup.missing:
{what} is not installed on this computer. The app cannot start without it (the window stays black).

Open the download page? Restart the app after installing.
startup.webview2_broken: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (the installation is broken and must be reinstalled)
startup.webview2_failed:
WebView2 could not start; its installation looks broken (the window stays black).

Fix: on the page that opens, download "Evergreen Standalone Installer" → x64 and run it as administrator. If it says "already installed", first uninstall WebView2 Runtime from Apps.

Open the download page?
rail.label: Favourite streamers
top.linkPlaceholder: Type a streamer name or paste a link: channel, VOD or clip
home.emptyText: Type the streamer's name in the box above, or paste a channel, VOD or clip link.
home.step1: Open the streamer. Their past streams, clips and, if live, the live stream are listed.
home.step2: Click a video. It plays large in the middle; download all of it or pick parts with Cut. To download several, select them with the box in the card's corner.
home.step3: Press the star. The streamer is added to the left rail; you get notified when they go live and when a new stream arrives.
home.importTip: Add a cuts file you exported earlier
home.exportTip: Write all saved cuts to a file
home.savedCutsEmpty: What you mark in the cut editor is kept here; close it and continue later.
ch.label: Channel
ch.autoDlTip: Download this streamer's new streams automatically when they end (while the app is open; ones that arrived while it was closed download on next start)
ch.autoRecTip: Start recording automatically when the streamer goes live
lib.title: Downloads
lib.emptyText: Every video, clip and cut you download stays here. Click to play it in the middle; you can show the file in its folder or delete it.
set.qualityDesc: If unavailable, the nearest lower quality downloads.
set.fileNameDesc: Cuts get their time range appended.
set.parallelDesc: Auto: the app measures total speed and adjusts itself. Clips always use the highest number.
set.threadsDesc: How many connections fetch one video's parts.
set.limitDesc: Total for all downloads, so the line is not fully used while you game or watch streams.
set.hoverDesc: Hovering a card plays the video muted.
set.mutedDesc: When off, the player opens at the saved volume.
set.notifyDoneDesc: One Windows notification when everything in the queue is done.
set.sectionLenDesc: Length of the cut added with <kbd>K</kbd> in the cut editor.
set.remuxDesc: When off, the recording stays .ts; the app's player cannot open .ts.
set.clipboardDesc: When you return to the window and the clipboard holds a Kick link, offers to open it.
set.updatesDesc: Looks for a new version at startup.
settings.language.desc: Interface language. The window reloads; downloads keep running.
sb.freeTip: Free space on the download folder's drive
after.label: When done
after.tip: When everything in the queue is done
drop.title: Drop the link
drop.text: Channel, VOD or clip links open
keys.pasteLink: Paste a link and open it (when not typing in a box)
keys.dragDropDesc: Drop a link from the browser onto the window
keys.clickDesc: Watch (while selecting: add to / remove from selection)
keys.foot: The cut editor has its own shortcuts, under Shortcuts at its top right.
cut.goLiveTip: Loads the stream's newest moment and jumps there; the cuts you added stay
cut.k.inOut: Mark in and out; O creates the cut
cut.k.add: Cut of the preset length around the current moment
cut.k.pull: Move the selected cut's start / end here
cut.k.esc: Clear the mark or selection, then close
cut.chainTip: Play the cuts in order, skipping the gaps
cut.empty.find: Find the moment you want, then:
cut.empty.in: Press where the cut should start.
cut.empty.out: Press where it should end. The cut is ready.
cut.empty.add: Or with one key, drop a cut of the preset length around the current moment.
cut.empty.edit: Adjust the edges by dragging them on the timeline or by typing times here.
cut.chatFailed: Chat activity could not be loaded.
cut.overviewTip: Whole stream: click or drag to move the visible part
live.recordTip: Records the stream from now on; becomes mp4 when you stop or the stream ends
live.cutTip: Pick any moment from the stream's start until now; downloads while the stream is still running
card.cutTip: Cut: pick parts from inside the stream

cut.stillAdd: You can still add cuts; type their times on the right.

cut.withChatTip: Also download each cut's chat, with the same name as the video
set.chatAutoDesc: When a stream, cut, clip or live recording finishes, its chat downloads too, with the same name. The cut editor can turn this off per download.
set.chatFormatsDesc: Which files the chat is saved as. At least one.
set.chatVideoDesc: Used by the Video file type, "Make chat video" in Downloads and the chat panel.

chat.fmtTip.ass: VLC and MPC show the chat over the video when it has the same name

chat.fmtTip.html: Opens in the browser with colours, badges and emotes
chat.fmtTip.video: The chat as a separate scrolling video; options below

chat.panel.empty: No messages yet at this point
chat.panel.seekTip: Go to this moment in the video
chat.panel.none: No chat is available for this video.
chat.img.optsTip: How the image looks: background, width, time, badges, emotes

chat.vid.transparentTip: A .webm with a transparent background; slower to make
chat.vid.makeTip: Draws this chat as a scrolling video (Settings → Chat sets its look)
chat.vid.queued: Chat video queued; it appears in Downloads when ready
chat.vid.selTip: Make a short chat video of the selected messages
usage.title: Help make Kick Downloader better
usage.intro: Can the app send anonymous usage data? It shows how many people use which version, how fast downloads are on real connections, and which errors happen, so we know what to fix and speed up first.
usage.sends: App version, Windows version and language|A random install ID (not linked to you)|Hardware: processor, memory, graphics card, screen, SSD or HDD|For each download: type, channel name, size, duration, speed and download settings|Which features are used (cut editor, chat panel, chat video…)|Errors: error type and where in the code
usage.never: Your IP address (not stored)|Video links and titles|File names and folders|Your Windows user name|Anything you type
usage.change: Data goes to PostHog servers in the EU. You can change this any time in Settings → App.
usage.settingDesc: Version, hardware, download speeds, used features and errors. No links, titles or files.
err.capcutMissing: CapCut is not installed. Install CapCut for Windows and try again.
err.capcutProbe: Could not read the video's length and size. The file may be damaged.
err.capcutWrite: Could not write the CapCut project. Check that the CapCut drafts folder is writable.
capcut.done: CapCut project "{name}" is ready. If CapCut was already open, restart it to see the project.
capcut.cutsTip: Downloads the cuts, then puts them one after another in a new CapCut project at the stream's own size and opens CapCut.
capcut.cutsQueued: {n} cuts are downloading. CapCut opens when they are done.
capcut.cutsFailed: A cut did not download, so the CapCut project was not made. Retry the cut in Downloads.
